result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, supplemented by 'No Turn on Red' signage. The environment is primarily residential with continuous sidewalks and mature street trees, though it lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Large mature trees at the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively fast right-turning movements by vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The wide turn radius at the intersection may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner on the left side of the image

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and lack of traffic calming measures create a moderately high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to continental style for better visibility.
